study type: Observational study drawing data from a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Collegial midwifery assistance (second midwife present) during the active second stage of labor
Duration of time spent in the birthing room by the second midwife
outcome: Primary midwives' confidence in collegial midwifery assistance
Primary midwives' positive experience toward collegial midwifery assistance
cohort: Primary midwives who participated in the Oneplus multicenter randomized controlled trial.
finding: The majority of primary midwives (61%) felt confident and (56%) were positive toward collegial midwifery assistance during the active second stage of labor, with less experienced midwives (less than 2 years) being more likely to agree.
cross-section timing: Data collected after birth, reflecting experiences during the active second stage of labor.
